nodes.label: Two Build Rules (explicit venv, forward slashes)
nodes.rationale: Two rules that prevent almost all build problems.
nodes.norm_label: two build rules (explicit venv, forward slashes)

nodes.label: Explicit .venv python.exe Rule
nodes.rationale: Bare python follows PATH and may resolve to a different interpreter (global, Store, conda) even with a venv activated.

nodes.label: Forward-slash Path Rule
nodes.rationale: Forward slashes work in PowerShell and Git Bash; backslashes are escapes in Git Bash and mangle the venv path.

nodes.label: Nuitka Bundles From the Running Interpreter
nodes.rationale: Missing modules only warn and still produce a broken .exe, so the build uses the explicit venv path and check_engine runs the built engine on synthetic PDFs.
nodes.norm_label: nuitka bundles from the running interpreter

nodes.label: Query: Why ExpCore class bridges Parser Bupot, Rekening Koran BCA & CIMB, docs and Release 3.0.0
nodes.rationale: Structural bridge: one class holds every parser (degree 55, betweenness 0.127; 45 EXTRACTED method edges, 20 to BCA/CIMB + Excel helpers, 19 to Bupot/rename). Docs link via expcore_engine imports and DESIGN Python Engine; Release 3.0.0 only via the ExpCore.py contains edge. Removing ExpCore raises components 7 -> 10.
nodes.norm_label: query: why expcore class bridges parser bupot, rekening koran bca & cimb, docs and release 3.0.0

nodes.label: Query: Impact of changing shared Excel helpers (_write_rekening_excel <-> _write_cimb_excel)
nodes.rationale: Both writers share _judul_excel/_nama_sheet/_tulis_panel/_tautan_sheet/_rapikan_tabel; graph missed alias calls (angka = cls._angka, uang = cls._teks_uang) and class constants (_GAYA_HASIL, _FORMAT_UANG, _ISI_JUDUL, _UANG) are not nodes, so impact analysis needs graph + grep.

nodes.rationale: One table for filter/pivot; sorted by category, account, then chronologically within each account so SALDO stays that account running balance.

nodes.label: CIMB Cell Grouping by Table Border Lines
nodes.rationale: A CIMB transaction is one multi-line table cell with date/amount centered; rows are grouped by border lines and columns derived from lines under a verified header, not text order.
nodes.norm_label: cimb cell grouping by table border lines

nodes.label: CIMB Automatic Check (accounts, running balance, category totals)
nodes.norm_label: cimb automatic check (accounts, running balance, category totals)

nodes.label: Foreign-currency Amounts & Saldo Ekuivalen IDR
nodes.rationale: Foreign amounts stay in original currency; use Mata Uang or Saldo Ekuivalen IDR before summing across accounts.

nodes.label: CIMB Sections Recognized by Title, Not Page Number
nodes.rationale: Page, account and transaction counts vary monthly, so sections are found by title and content; deposits, MLD, credit cards and Poin Xtra are ignored.
nodes.norm_label: cimb sections recognized by title, not page number

nodes.label: Duplicate Statement Flagged PERLU CEK (no PDF dropped)
nodes.rationale: Same account+period (BCA) or same CIF+report date (CIMB) in more than one PDF is marked PERLU CEK on every copy with the other copy location, so transactions are not silently double-counted; nothing is discarded and the user picks the copy.
nodes.norm_label: duplicate statement flagged perlu cek (no pdf dropped)

nodes.label: Local-only Processing (no upload)
nodes.rationale: All processing runs locally; PDFs and extraction results are never sent to the internet.

nodes.label: Empty Name Source Skips PDF (no fallback)
nodes.rationale: If the chosen name source is empty the PDF is skipped instead of silently using the other source; CSV still logs both names for audit.
nodes.norm_label: empty name source skips pdf (no fallback)

nodes.label: Ambiguous Data Is Never Guessed
nodes.rationale: PDFs are skipped when not exactly one sifat box is checked, object rows have differing masa, or H.2 is unreadable, rather than guessing.

nodes.label: Rekening Koran Automatic Check (Hasil Cek / PERLU CEK)
nodes.rationale: Totals and counts vs PDF summary, running balance vs every printed balance, and page completeness are checked so discrepancies surface as PERLU CEK with reasons.
nodes.norm_label: rekening koran automatic check (hasil cek / perlu cek)

nodes.label: Sifat Read From H.4/H.5 Checkbox
nodes.rationale: If not exactly one box is checked the column holds - instead of a guess.

nodes.label: PDF Summary in Side Panel (SUM counts only transactions)
nodes.rationale: Statement summary (SALDO AWAL, MUTASI CR/DB + counts, SALDO AKHIR) goes in a panel right of the table, never below it or merged into KETERANGAN, so SUM/filter/sort on DEBIT/CREDIT only count transactions.
nodes.norm_label: pdf summary in side panel (sum counts only transactions)

nodes.label: Manual 2.x Uninstall Requirement
nodes.rationale: 3.x installer does not remove 2.x; without manual uninstall there are two entries and removing the old one later can break 3.x in the same folder.

nodes.label: Wrapped Descriptions Joined With a Space
nodes.rationale: Cannot distinguish a split word from separate columns, so no word-joining is guessed.
nodes.norm_label: wrapped descriptions joined with a space

nodes.label: Release 1.1.1 (2026-06-10)
nodes.rationale: Excel output names are prefixed with ! so they sort to the top of the folder.

nodes.label: Format-mismatch PDFs Skipped & Logged
nodes.rationale: Choosing the wrong Bukti Potong menu cannot corrupt data: non-matching PDFs are skipped and logged.
